summary: In this excerpt from Book 1 (part 190), the narrator Marcus is held in a detention facility after the DHS has been expelled from the State. A woman (likely a lawyer or official) tells him the old justice system is being restored, that he will be held somewhere safer than a juvenile facility on the mainland until he is bailed out, and that officers involved in secret imprisonments will face jail. Marcus is numb, then searches the cell-block calling for his friends Ange Carvelli and Darryl Glover, who are not found and are presumed shipped overseas. He sits despairing and thinks bitterly of Severe Haircut Woman, who he blames for the abuses.
one_line: Marcus, freed from a DHS detention facility, searches the cells for friends Ange and Darryl while learning the old justice system is being restored.
key_facts: The Governor has thrown the DHS out of the State and dismantled every checkpoint.
The Attorney General has issued warrants for law-enforcement officers involved in 'stress interrogations' and secret imprisonments.
The speaker says the bizarro-world justice system is being replaced with the old system of judges, open trials and lawyers.
The speaker tells Marcus that juvie facilities on the mainland can be really rough, so the current facility may be the best place for him until he is bailed out.
The speaker says the situation will be humane, with real food, no interrogations and visits from family.
Marcus notes that he had not yet been charged but there were bound to be plenty of charges.
Marcus wants to find Ange and Darryl and tries to use a computer to look up their cell-numbers, but it requires a password.
Marcus calls out 'Ange Carvelli! Darryl Glover! It's Marcus!' along the cell-block corridors without an answer.
Prisoners behind the cell-doors scream, cry or beg to be released because they do not understand what has happened.
Former guards are being herded onto the docks in plastic handcuffs and taken away by California state SWAT teams.
Marcus believes Ange and Darryl were shipped overseas to Syria or worse and that he will never see them again.
Marcus recalls Severe Haircut Woman smirking as she asked him for his login and blames her for what happened.
The speaker says the group has an hour or two before officials return to put Marcus away again.
The group raided the facility's staff room on the way in, which had gourmet food.
